title: Call for abstracts, RITA Conference 2027
summary: Present your research at the first RITA Conference, 9–10 September 2027. Nine tracks on Africa’s green industrial transformation. Free to submit.
body:
RITA 2027 asks what it takes to industrialise through the green transition: the states, finance, value chains, energy, firms and workers that turn resources into production and jobs.

Submit a 300–500 word abstract for a paper, poster, organised panel or policy roundtable. Every abstract gets two reviews. Accepted papers are presented with a discussant, and strong full papers are invited to the RITA Working Paper Series.

Travel support is available on application for Africa-based PhD candidates and early-career researchers.
